gaps.sentence: The island is ___ , with no permanent residents (HABIT).
gaps.explanation: 'No permanent residents' shows the negative: uninhabited (un- + inhabited). An adjective is needed after 'is'.

gaps.sentence: The mixture will ___ as it cools (SOLID).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ify forms the verb: solidify means to become solid. A base verb follows 'will'.

gaps.sentence: New technology has ___ the way we work (REVOLUTION).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ise forms the verb: revolutionise. After 'has' the past participle 'revolutionised' is needed.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the train was announced.
gaps.explanation: The subject must be a noun: arrival (-al noun of 'arrive').

gaps.sentence: The tracks become ___ after heavy rain (ACCESS).
gaps.explanation: Heavy rain blocks the tracks, so the negative adjective 'inaccessible' (in- + accessible) is needed.
The prefix un- forms the negative adjective: unusual. An adjective is needed after 'was'.

gaps.sentence: The government wants to ___ the tax system (SIMPLE).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ify forms the verb: simplify means to make simple. A base verb follows 'to'.

gaps.sentence: This guidebook is really ___ for travellers (USE).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ful means full of: useful. 'Useless' is the negative opposite.
